claim_a: MYC and BCL2 dual protein expression on immunohistochemistry identifies a double-expressor DLBCL subset with inferior overall survival.
claim_b: Concurrent immunohistochemical positivity for MYC and BCL2 in DLBCL defines double-expressor lymphoma and is associated with worse prognosis.
rationale: Both claims describe MYC/BCL2 dual IHC expression as a double-expressor subset with poor outcome.

claim_a: BRAF V600E mutation in colorectal adenocarcinoma is strongly associated with the CpG island methylator phenotype and MLH1 promoter hypermethylation.
claim_b: In colorectal cancer, BRAF V600E mutations cluster with CIMP-high tumors that show silencing of MLH1 by promoter methylation.
rationale: Equivalent statements linking BRAF V600E to CIMP and MLH1 methylation.

claim_a: Microvascular invasion identified on histologic examination of resected hepatocellular carcinoma is an independent predictor of post-resection recurrence.
claim_b: Presence of microvascular invasion in HCC resection specimens independently increases the risk of tumor recurrence after surgery.
rationale: Same finding about microvascular invasion and recurrence in HCC.

claim_a: High stromal tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte counts in triple-negative breast cancer are associated with improved disease-free survival.
claim_b: Elevated stromal TIL density in triple-negative breast carcinoma correlates with longer disease-free survival outcomes.
rationale: Both assert improved DFS with high TILs in TNBC.

claim_a: Cribriform architecture in prostatic acinar adenocarcinoma upgrades the Gleason pattern to 4 and predicts adverse outcomes.
claim_b: Identification of cribriform glands in prostate adenocarcinoma warrants Gleason pattern 4 assignment and is linked to worse prognosis.
rationale: Both claims tie cribriform architecture to Gleason 4 and unfavorable outcome.

claim_a: HER2 positivity in metastatic gastric adenocarcinoma predicts clinical benefit from trastuzumab-containing chemotherapy regimens.
claim_b: Patients with HER2-amplified advanced gastric cancer derive improved response when trastuzumab is added to first-line chemotherapy.
rationale: Both support HER2-directed therapy benefit in gastric cancer.

claim_a: MGMT promoter methylation in glioblastoma is associated with improved response to temozolomide and prolonged survival.
claim_b: Glioblastomas harboring MGMT promoter hypermethylation show better outcomes following temozolomide-based therapy.
rationale: Equivalent claims about MGMT methylation and TMZ response.

claim_a: DOG1 immunohistochemistry is a sensitive marker for gastrointestinal stromal tumors, including KIT-negative cases.
claim_b: DOG1 staining reliably identifies GISTs and remains positive in many tumors lacking CD117 expression.
rationale: Both describe DOG1 sensitivity in GIST including KIT-negative cases.

claim_a: Increased Breslow thickness in cutaneous melanoma correlates with higher rates of sentinel lymph node metastasis.
claim_b: Thicker primary melanomas measured by Breslow depth carry a greater likelihood of sentinel node positivity.
rationale: Same direction between Breslow thickness and SLN positivity.

claim_a: EGFR exon 19 deletions in lung adenocarcinoma confer sensitivity to first-line EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy.
claim_b: Lung adenocarcinomas with exon 19 EGFR deletions respond favorably to upfront EGFR-TKI treatment.
rationale: Both describe EGFR exon 19 deletion sensitivity to TKIs.

claim_a: Calretinin immunostaining is positive in epithelioid mesothelioma and negative in most pulmonary adenocarcinomas.
claim_b: Calretinin expression is typically absent in epithelioid mesothelioma and reliably positive in lung adenocarcinoma.
rationale: Directly reversed expression pattern claims.

claim_a: High tumor stromal density in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is associated with shorter overall survival.
claim_b: Dense desmoplastic stroma in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma correlates with longer overall survival.
rationale: Opposite survival directions for the same stromal feature.

claim_a: POLE-ultramutated endometrial carcinomas exhibit an excellent prognosis despite high-grade morphology.
claim_b: POLE-mutated endometrial carcinomas have particularly poor outcomes even when low-grade.
rationale: Opposite prognostic claims for POLE-mutated endometrial cancer.

claim_a: BCL2 protein expression by immunohistochemistry is characteristically positive in follicular lymphoma germinal center cells.
claim_b: Neoplastic follicles in follicular lymphoma are consistently BCL2-negative on immunohistochemistry.
rationale: Direct negation of BCL2 positivity in follicular lymphoma.

claim_a: KRAS exon 2 mutations in metastatic colorectal cancer predict resistance to anti-EGFR monoclonal antibody therapy.
claim_b: KRAS exon 2 mutated metastatic colorectal cancers respond well to cetuximab and panitumumab.
rationale: Opposite predictions of EGFR antibody response based on KRAS status.

claim_a: WHO/ISUP nucleolar grading is prognostically informative in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
claim_b: WHO/ISUP nucleolar grade has no prognostic relevance in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
rationale: Direct negation about prognostic value of ISUP grading.

claim_a: Psammoma bodies are a characteristic histologic feature of papillary thyroid carcinoma.
claim_b: Psammoma bodies are essentially never encountered in papillary thyroid carcinoma.
rationale: Negation of a classic morphologic association.

claim_a: Synovial sarcoma is defined by a recurrent t(X;18) translocation involving SS18 and SSX gene fusion.
claim_b: Synovial sarcoma lacks recurrent translocations and is genetically characterized by complex karyotypes.
rationale: Mutually exclusive genetic descriptions of synovial sarcoma.

claim_a: Lymphovascular invasion in muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma is an adverse prognostic indicator after cystectomy.
claim_b: Lymphovascular invasion identified at cystectomy has no independent prognostic significance in urothelial carcinoma.
rationale: Conflicting claims about LVI prognostic value.

claim_a: Synaptophysin and chromogranin A are reliable immunohistochemical markers for well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors.
claim_b: Well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors typically fail to express synaptophysin or chromogranin A.
rationale: Direct contradiction on NET marker expression.

claim_a: Estrogen receptor expression by immunohistochemistry guides selection for endocrine therapy in invasive breast carcinoma.
claim_b: Ki-67 proliferation index thresholds remain inconsistently defined across laboratories assessing breast carcinoma.
rationale: Same disease but different markers and unrelated assertions.

claim_a: ALK rearrangements in lung adenocarcinoma are detected by break-apart FISH or immunohistochemistry with D5F3 clone.
claim_b: Small cell lung carcinoma frequently shows inactivation of RB1 and TP53 tumor suppressor genes.
rationale: Different lung tumor types and different molecular topics.

claim_a: Mallory-Denk bodies are eosinophilic cytoplasmic hyaline inclusions seen in alcoholic and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis.
claim_b: Centrilobular necrosis is the histologic hallmark of acute acetaminophen-induced hepatotoxicity.
rationale: Both liver topics but describe distinct lesions.

claim_a: MDM2 amplification detected by FISH supports the diagnosis of well-differentiated liposarcoma over benign lipoma.
claim_b: STAT6 nuclear immunostaining is a sensitive and specific marker of solitary fibrous tumor.
rationale: Two soft tissue tumors with unrelated diagnostic markers.

claim_a: FIGO staging of cervical carcinoma incorporates tumor size and parametrial involvement assessed clinically and pathologically.
claim_b: Serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma is recognized as a precursor lesion of high-grade pelvic serous carcinoma.
rationale: Both gynecologic but discuss unrelated entities and concepts.

claim_a: TP53 mutations in chronic lymphocytic leukemia confer resistance to chemoimmunotherapy and shorter survival.
claim_b: JAK2 V617F mutation underlies the majority of polycythemia vera cases and most essential thrombocythemia.
rationale: Different hematologic entities and different molecular contexts.

claim_a: Pautrier microabscesses are intraepidermal collections of atypical lymphocytes typical of mycosis fungoides.
claim_b: Acantholysis with suprabasal cleft formation characterizes the histology of pemphigus vulgaris.
rationale: Two unrelated dermatopathology entities.

claim_a: PD-L1 expression in metastatic melanoma is associated with improved response to immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
claim_b: NRAS mutations occur in a subset of cutaneous melanomas and are mutually exclusive with BRAF mutations.
rationale: Same disease but different markers and unrelated assertions.

claim_a: Basal cell loss demonstrated by absent p63 and high-molecular-weight cytokeratin staining supports prostatic adenocarcinoma diagnosis.
claim_b: PIN-4 cocktail combining racemase with basal markers aids distinction between benign and malignant prostatic glands.
rationale: Both prostate IHC topics but make different non-overlapping assertions.

claim_a: IDH-wildtype diffuse astrocytomas with TERT promoter mutations behave clinically like glioblastoma regardless of histologic grade.
claim_b: Medulloblastoma is now classified into molecular subgroups including WNT, SHH, group 3, and group 4.
rationale: Both CNS tumors but address unrelated entities and classifications.

claim_a: IDH1 R132H mutations are characteristic of diffuse astrocytomas and oligodendrogliomas in younger adults.
claim_b: Diffuse gliomas in younger adults frequently harbor IDH1 R132H mutations, particularly astrocytic and oligodendroglial subtypes.
rationale: Both claims describe the same IDH1 R132H association with adult diffuse gliomas.

claim_a: Loss of basal cell markers p63 and high-molecular-weight cytokeratin supports a diagnosis of prostatic adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: Absence of p63 staining in atypical prostatic glands is consistent with invasive adenocarcinoma rather than a benign mimic.
rationale: Claim B follows directly from claim A's diagnostic principle.

claim_a: High tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte density is associated with improved overall survival in triple-negative breast cancer.
claim_b: Dense stromal lymphocytic infiltrates correlate with better prognosis in patients with triple-negative breast carcinoma.
rationale: Same favorable prognostic association of TILs in TNBC.

claim_a: FIGO grade 3 endometrioid carcinoma shows more than 50% solid non-squamous growth.
claim_b: Endometrioid endometrial carcinomas with predominantly solid architecture beyond half the tumor are classified as high grade.
rationale: Both restate FIGO grade 3 criterion.

claim_a: HER2 overexpression in gastric adenocarcinoma predicts response to trastuzumab-containing chemotherapy regimens.
claim_b: Trastuzumab efficacy in advanced gastric cancer is largely confined to tumors with HER2 amplification or overexpression.
rationale: Both indicate HER2 status as predictive for trastuzumab response.

claim_a: Papillary thyroid carcinoma displays nuclear grooves, pseudoinclusions, and overlapping ground-glass nuclei.
claim_b: Characteristic nuclear features including grooves and intranuclear pseudoinclusions define papillary thyroid carcinoma.
rationale: Both describe diagnostic nuclear features of PTC.

claim_a: Microsatellite-instability-high colorectal cancers show better response to immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
claim_b: MSI-high colorectal tumors are sensitive to anti-PD-1 immunotherapy due to high neoantigen load.
rationale: Claim B elaborates the mechanism behind A.

claim_a: Breslow thickness remains the most important prognostic factor in localized cutaneous melanoma.
claim_b: Depth of invasion measured as Breslow thickness strongly predicts survival in primary cutaneous melanoma.
rationale: Both state Breslow thickness as key prognostic factor.

claim_a: GIST tumors typically express CD117 (KIT) and DOG1 on immunohistochemistry.
claim_b: Most gastrointestinal stromal tumors are positive for KIT and DOG1 by immunostaining.
rationale: Same IHC profile of GIST.

claim_a: MYC and BCL2 double-expressor DLBCL carries inferior prognosis compared with non-double-expressor cases.
claim_b: Co-expression of MYC and BCL2 by immunohistochemistry identifies a DLBCL subgroup with worse clinical outcomes.
rationale: Both describe poor prognosis of double-expressor DLBCL.

claim_a: IDH-mutant astrocytomas show significantly longer overall survival than IDH-wildtype glioblastomas.
claim_b: IDH mutation status has no significant impact on survival in adult diffuse gliomas.
rationale: Direct contradiction on prognostic value of IDH mutation.

claim_a: Glypican-3 immunostaining is a sensitive marker for hepatocellular carcinoma and is typically negative in benign liver lesions.
claim_b: Glypican-3 is frequently positive in cirrhotic regenerative nodules and lacks specificity for hepatocellular carcinoma.
rationale: Opposite claims about glypican-3 specificity.

claim_a: High stromal SMAD4 loss in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is associated with worse overall survival.
claim_b: SMAD4 loss in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma does not influence patient survival outcomes.
rationale: One claims prognostic association, the other denies it.

claim_a: EGFR exon 19 deletions predict robust response to first-line tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy in lung adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: EGFR exon 19 deletions confer primary resistance to tyrosine kinase inhibitors in pulmonary adenocarcinoma.
rationale: Opposite treatment-response claims.

claim_a: Capsular and vascular invasion are required to distinguish follicular carcinoma from follicular adenoma.
claim_b: Follicular carcinoma can be diagnosed on cytology alone without evidence of capsular or vascular invasion.
rationale: Mutually exclusive diagnostic criteria.

claim_a: Gleason pattern 4 cribriform architecture is associated with adverse outcomes including biochemical recurrence.
claim_b: Cribriform Gleason pattern 4 has prognostic significance equivalent to non-cribriform pattern 4 with no adverse implications.
rationale: Disagree about prognostic impact of cribriform pattern.

claim_a: BRAF V600E mutations are most frequently found in melanomas arising on chronically sun-damaged skin.
claim_b: BRAF V600E mutations predominate in melanomas of intermittently sun-exposed skin and are uncommon in chronic sun-damage melanomas.
rationale: Direct contradiction on UV-exposure context of BRAF mutations.

claim_a: Loss of BAP1 nuclear expression by immunohistochemistry supports a diagnosis of malignant mesothelioma over reactive mesothelial proliferation.
claim_b: BAP1 staining is retained in malignant mesothelioma and lost in reactive mesothelial hyperplasia.
rationale: Inverted relationship of BAP1 loss with malignancy.

claim_a: Sarcomatoid differentiation in clear cell renal cell carcinoma confers significantly worse prognosis.
claim_b: Sarcomatoid features in renal cell carcinoma have minimal prognostic impact compared with conventional histology.
rationale: Opposite prognostic claims about sarcomatoid RCC.

claim_a: Lymphovascular invasion in stage II colorectal cancer is an indication for considering adjuvant chemotherapy.
claim_b: Lymphovascular invasion in stage II colorectal cancer is not considered a high-risk feature warranting adjuvant treatment.
rationale: Direct disagreement on clinical management implication.

claim_a: Invasive lobular carcinoma classically shows single-file infiltration and loss of E-cadherin expression.
claim_b: Ductal carcinoma in situ is characterized by neoplastic cells confined within the ductal basement membrane.
rationale: Different breast lesion subtypes, neither supporting nor contradicting.

claim_a: Synaptophysin and chromogranin A are standard markers for confirming neuroendocrine differentiation.
claim_b: Ki-67 proliferation index is used to grade well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors of the gastrointestinal tract.
rationale: Both involve NETs but address different aspects (diagnosis vs grading).

claim_a: Synovial sarcoma is defined by the t(X;18)(p11;q11) translocation involving SS18 and SSX genes.
claim_b: Ewing sarcoma harbors EWSR1-FLI1 fusion resulting from t(11;22)(q24;q12) translocation.
rationale: Different sarcoma entities with distinct fusions.

claim_a: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma typically presents at advanced stage with peritoneal dissemination.
claim_b: BRCA1/2 mutations in ovarian carcinoma predict sensitivity to PARP inhibitor therapy.
rationale: Same disease but separate facets (presentation vs therapy).

claim_a: High-grade urothelial carcinoma shows marked nuclear pleomorphism and loss of polarity.
claim_b: Schistosoma haematobium infection predisposes to squamous cell carcinoma of the urinary bladder.
rationale: Bladder cancers but different histologic types and contexts.

claim_a: Reed-Sternberg cells in classical Hodgkin lymphoma are typically CD30 and CD15 positive.
claim_b: Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma contains LP cells positive for CD20 and OCT2.
rationale: Different Hodgkin lymphoma subtypes with distinct IHC profiles.

claim_a: BCR-ABL1 fusion drives chronic myeloid leukemia and is targeted by tyrosine kinase inhibitors such as imatinib.
claim_b: JAK2 V617F mutation is the most common driver in polycythemia vera and essential thrombocythemia.
rationale: Different myeloproliferative neoplasms with distinct drivers.

claim_a: MDM2 amplification detected by FISH supports diagnosis of well-differentiated liposarcoma over benign lipoma.
claim_b: STAT6 nuclear immunoreactivity is a sensitive and specific marker of solitary fibrous tumor.
rationale: Both are soft tissue diagnostics but involve distinct entities and markers.

claim_a: Helicobacter pylori gastritis shows lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate with curved bacilli along the surface epithelium.
claim_b: Celiac disease biopsies demonstrate villous atrophy, crypt hyperplasia, and intraepithelial lymphocytosis in duodenum.
rationale: Different GI inflammatory conditions.

claim_a: MGMT promoter methylation in glioblastoma predicts improved response to temozolomide chemotherapy.
claim_b: 1p/19q codeletion is a defining molecular feature of oligodendroglioma and confers chemosensitivity.
rationale: Both glial tumor biomarkers but different entities and markers.

claim_a: IDH1 R132H mutations are detected in the majority of WHO grade 2 and 3 astrocytomas.
claim_b: Most diffuse astrocytomas of WHO grade 2 or 3 harbor an IDH1 R132H mutation.
rationale: Both claims state the same prevalence relationship between IDH1 R132H and lower-grade astrocytomas.

claim_a: DOG1 immunohistochemistry is positive in most gastrointestinal stromal tumors, including KIT-negative cases.
claim_b: DOG1 staining identifies GISTs even when CD117 expression is absent.
rationale: The second claim entails the first by emphasizing DOG1's utility in KIT-negative GIST.

claim_a: High stromal tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte density is associated with improved overall survival in triple-negative breast cancer.
claim_b: Increased stromal TIL infiltration confers a favorable prognosis in TNBC patients.
rationale: Both describe the same prognostic association between stromal TILs and survival in TNBC.

claim_a: Reed-Sternberg cells in classic Hodgkin lymphoma typically show bilobed nuclei with prominent eosinophilic nucleoli.
claim_b: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma is characterized by large binucleated cells containing macronucleoli resembling owl eyes.
rationale: Both describe the same morphologic hallmark of Reed-Sternberg cells.

claim_a: Mismatch repair-deficient colorectal cancers show durable responses to PD-1 checkpoint blockade.
claim_b: MSI-high colorectal tumors are particularly responsive to anti-PD-1 immunotherapy.
rationale: MMR-deficient and MSI-high are equivalent in CRC, so both claims report the same response.

claim_a: Gleason grade group 5 prostate cancer is associated with significantly higher rates of biochemical recurrence than grade group 1.
claim_b: Patients with Gleason 9-10 prostate carcinoma experience worse PSA recurrence-free survival than those with Gleason 6 disease.
rationale: Both convey worse biochemical outcomes for highest-grade compared to lowest-grade prostate cancer.

claim_a: Synovial sarcoma is defined by the recurrent t(X;18)(p11;q11) translocation producing SS18-SSX fusion transcripts.
claim_b: The SS18-SSX gene fusion arising from t(X;18) is a defining molecular feature of synovial sarcoma.
rationale: Both describe the same defining translocation in synovial sarcoma.

claim_a: Expression of MYC and BCL2 proteins by immunohistochemistry defines double-expressor DLBCL with adverse prognosis.
claim_b: Co-expression of MYC and BCL2 by IHC identifies a DLBCL subgroup with inferior outcomes.
rationale: Both describe double-expressor DLBCL as having worse prognosis.

claim_a: Increasing Breslow thickness correlates with decreased melanoma-specific survival.
claim_b: Thicker primary melanomas measured by Breslow depth predict poorer disease-specific outcomes.
rationale: Both convey the same prognostic association of Breslow thickness.

claim_a: Nuclear grooves, pseudoinclusions, and chromatin clearing are characteristic features of papillary thyroid carcinoma.
claim_b: The diagnosis of papillary thyroid carcinoma relies on nuclear features including clearing, grooves, and intranuclear inclusions.
rationale: Both list the same diagnostic nuclear features.

claim_a: MGMT promoter methylation predicts a favorable response to temozolomide in glioblastoma patients.
claim_b: MGMT promoter methylation does not influence temozolomide sensitivity in glioblastoma.
rationale: Direct negation regarding MGMT methylation and TMZ response.

claim_a: HER2 immunohistochemistry score of 3+ corresponds to HER2 gene amplification in nearly all cases.
claim_b: HER2 IHC 3+ results are frequently discordant with FISH amplification status in breast cancer.
rationale: The claims disagree about concordance between HER2 IHC 3+ and amplification.

claim_a: High tumor budding at the invasive front is associated with worse survival in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: Tumor budding intensity has no prognostic significance in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
rationale: Direct disagreement about prognostic value of budding in PDAC.

claim_a: EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations confer sensitivity to first-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
claim_b: EGFR exon 20 insertions are associated with primary resistance to standard EGFR-TKIs such as erlotinib.
rationale: Opposite assertions about TKI response in exon 20 insertion NSCLC.

claim_a: WNT-activated medulloblastoma carries the most favorable prognosis among molecular subgroups.
claim_b: WNT-activated medulloblastoma is the molecular subgroup with the worst clinical outcome.
rationale: Direct opposites regarding WNT medulloblastoma prognosis.

claim_a: FIGO grade 3 endometrioid endometrial carcinoma shows higher recurrence rates than grade 1 tumors.
claim_b: FIGO grade does not stratify recurrence risk in endometrioid endometrial carcinoma.
rationale: Claims disagree about prognostic role of FIGO grading.

claim_a: Loss of BAP1 nuclear expression supports the diagnosis of malignant mesothelioma over reactive mesothelial proliferation.
claim_b: BAP1 immunohistochemistry cannot distinguish malignant mesothelioma from benign mesothelial hyperplasia.
rationale: Disagree about utility of BAP1 IHC in mesothelioma diagnosis.

claim_a: Goblet cells are required for the histologic diagnosis of Barrett esophagus in many guidelines.
claim_b: Barrett esophagus can be diagnosed in the absence of intestinal metaplasia with goblet cells.
rationale: Claims express mutually exclusive diagnostic criteria for Barrett esophagus.

claim_a: Sarcomatoid differentiation in clear cell renal cell carcinoma is associated with poor overall survival.
claim_b: Sarcomatoid features in clear cell RCC do not impact overall survival outcomes.
rationale: Direct negation regarding sarcomatoid features and survival.

claim_a: Depth of invasion greater than 10 mm upstages oral squamous cell carcinoma in the AJCC 8th edition.
claim_b: Depth of invasion is not incorporated into AJCC 8th edition staging of oral squamous cell carcinoma.
rationale: Claims directly oppose each other on AJCC criteria.

claim_a: AMACR (P504S) immunohistochemistry is frequently positive in prostatic adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: PAX8 staining is consistently expressed in renal cell carcinoma of clear cell type.
rationale: Different markers in different tumors.

claim_a: FLT3-ITD mutations are associated with shorter remission duration in acute myeloid leukemia.
claim_b: BRAF V600E mutations are present in nearly all hairy cell leukemia cases.
rationale: Different mutations in different hematologic neoplasms.

claim_a: Duodenal biopsies in celiac disease show villous atrophy with intraepithelial lymphocytosis.
claim_b: Crypt abscesses with neutrophilic infiltration characterize active ulcerative colitis.
rationale: Different GI diseases with different histologic features.

claim_a: BRCA1/2 mutations in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma confer improved response to platinum chemotherapy.
claim_b: Mucinous ovarian carcinoma is associated with KRAS mutations in a substantial proportion of cases.
rationale: Different ovarian carcinoma subtypes and different molecular topics.

claim_a: Imatinib induces durable cytogenetic responses in chronic-phase chronic myeloid leukemia.
claim_b: Trastuzumab improves survival in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients.
rationale: Different targeted therapies in different malignancies.

claim_a: Ki-67 proliferation index is used to grade well-differentiated pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors.
claim_b: S100 immunohistochemistry is a sensitive marker for melanocytic lesions including melanoma.
rationale: Different markers used for different tumor categories.

claim_a: High-grade urothelial carcinoma exhibits marked nuclear pleomorphism and frequent mitoses.
claim_b: Follicular lymphoma is graded based on the number of centroblasts per high-power field.
rationale: Grading systems for unrelated neoplasms.

claim_a: EWSR1-FLI1 fusion transcripts are detected in the majority of Ewing sarcomas.
claim_b: H3 K27M mutations define diffuse midline glioma in pediatric patients.
rationale: Different sarcoma vs CNS tumor with different defining alterations.

claim_a: Lymph node ratio is an independent prognostic factor in resected gastric adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: Cervical cancer staging incorporates parametrial invasion as assessed by clinical and pathologic evaluation.
rationale: Different cancers and different staging considerations.

claim_a: Hepatocellular carcinoma frequently exhibits a trabecular growth pattern with bile production.
claim_b: Psammoma bodies are commonly identified within papillary serous carcinomas of the ovary.
rationale: Different morphologic features in unrelated tumors.

claim_a: IDH1 R132H mutation is associated with improved overall survival in diffuse astrocytomas compared to IDH-wildtype tumors.
claim_b: Diffuse astrocytomas harboring IDH1 R132H mutations show better overall survival than their IDH-wildtype counterparts.
rationale: Both claims state the same prognostic association in equivalent terms.

claim_a: Triple-negative breast cancers lack expression of estrogen receptor, progesterone receptor, and HER2 by immunohistochemistry.
claim_b: By definition, triple-negative breast carcinomas are negative for ER, PR, and HER2 on IHC and FISH testing.
rationale: Second claim elaborates on the definition asserted in the first.

claim_a: High tumor budding at the invasive front of colorectal carcinoma is associated with increased risk of lymph node metastasis.
claim_b: Colorectal cancers exhibiting prominent tumor budding more frequently demonstrate nodal involvement at resection.
rationale: Both link tumor budding with nodal metastasis risk.

claim_a: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma is characterized histologically by Reed-Sternberg cells in an inflammatory background.
claim_b: The diagnostic hallmark of classic Hodgkin lymphoma is identification of Reed-Sternberg cells within a mixed reactive infiltrate.
rationale: Equivalent descriptions of the diagnostic morphology.

claim_a: HER2 overexpression in gastric adenocarcinoma predicts response to trastuzumab-based therapy.
claim_b: Gastric adenocarcinomas with HER2 amplification benefit from incorporation of trastuzumab into first-line chemotherapy.
rationale: Both assert that HER2 positivity predicts trastuzumab benefit.

claim_a: Higher Gleason grade group is associated with increased risk of biochemical recurrence after radical prostatectomy.
claim_b: Prostate cancers with elevated Gleason grade groups show higher rates of PSA recurrence following surgical resection.
rationale: Equivalent statements about Gleason grade and recurrence.

claim_a: Synovial sarcoma is characterized by the SS18-SSX fusion gene resulting from t(X;18) translocation.
claim_b: Detection of an SS18-SSX gene fusion supports the diagnosis of synovial sarcoma in spindle cell neoplasms.
rationale: Second claim follows from the defining molecular feature.

claim_a: Gastrointestinal stromal tumors typically express CD117 (KIT) by immunohistochemistry.
claim_b: CD117 immunoreactivity is a characteristic feature of most gastrointestinal stromal tumors.
rationale: Same IHC finding restated.

claim_a: Increased Breslow thickness in cutaneous melanoma correlates with worse disease-specific survival.
claim_b: Thicker primary melanomas measured by Breslow depth are associated with poorer melanoma-specific outcomes.
rationale: Equivalent prognostic statements about Breslow thickness.

claim_a: Papillary thyroid carcinoma typically shows nuclear grooves, pseudoinclusions, and ground-glass chromatin.
claim_b: Characteristic nuclear features of papillary thyroid carcinoma include grooves, intranuclear pseudoinclusions, and optically clear chromatin.
rationale: Same nuclear features described.

claim_a: SMAD4 loss in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is associated with worse overall survival.
claim_b: SMAD4 loss in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma confers improved overall survival compared to SMAD4-intact tumors.
rationale: Direct opposite prognostic claims.

claim_a: Calretinin immunostaining is positive in epithelioid mesothelioma and aids distinction from pulmonary adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: Calretinin is consistently negative in epithelioid mesothelioma and therefore not useful for distinguishing it from adenocarcinoma.
rationale: Opposing claims about calretinin staining in mesothelioma.

claim_a: BRAF V600E mutation in metastatic colorectal cancer predicts poor response to anti-EGFR monoclonal antibody therapy.
claim_b: BRAF V600E mutations in metastatic colorectal cancer are predictive of robust benefit from anti-EGFR antibodies.
rationale: Opposing predictive claims about BRAF and anti-EGFR therapy.

claim_a: MYC and BCL2 double-expressor diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is associated with inferior survival compared to non-double-expressors.
claim_b: Double-expressor DLBCL with concurrent MYC and BCL2 protein expression shows survival equivalent to non-double-expressor cases.
rationale: Conflict between worse and equivalent survival.

claim_a: EGFR exon 19 deletions in lung adenocarcinoma predict sensitivity to first-line EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
claim_b: EGFR exon 19 deletions confer primary resistance to EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors in lung adenocarcinoma.
rationale: Opposite predictive claims for EGFR TKI response.

claim_a: FIGO grade 3 endometrioid endometrial carcinoma exhibits higher recurrence rates than grade 1 tumors.
claim_b: FIGO grade 3 endometrioid endometrial carcinomas recur less frequently than well-differentiated grade 1 tumors.
rationale: Direct opposite outcome statements.

claim_a: PAX8 is expressed in the majority of clear cell renal cell carcinomas.
claim_b: Clear cell renal cell carcinomas are typically negative for PAX8 by immunohistochemistry.
rationale: Opposing IHC expression claims.

claim_a: Medullary breast carcinoma shows pushing borders and a prominent lymphocytic infiltrate.
claim_b: Medullary breast carcinoma characteristically displays infiltrative borders with sparse stromal lymphocytes.
rationale: Opposing morphologic descriptions of the same entity.

claim_a: MGMT promoter methylation in glioblastoma predicts improved response to temozolomide chemotherapy.
claim_b: MGMT promoter methylation status has no impact on temozolomide response in glioblastoma patients.
rationale: Negation of predictive association.

claim_a: Depth of invasion greater than 10 mm in oral squamous cell carcinoma is associated with increased nodal metastasis risk.
claim_b: Depth of invasion in oral squamous cell carcinoma does not influence the likelihood of cervical lymph node involvement.
rationale: Association vs no association for the same parameter.

claim_a: GATA3 immunohistochemistry is useful for identifying breast carcinoma in metastatic settings.
claim_b: TTF-1 immunohistochemistry supports a lung origin in metastatic adenocarcinoma of unknown primary.
rationale: Different markers and tumor origins discussed.

claim_a: BRAF V600E mutations occur in approximately half of cutaneous melanomas.
claim_b: NRAS Q61 mutations are found in a subset of cutaneous melanomas and are mutually exclusive with BRAF mutations.
rationale: Both describe different mutations in melanoma without supporting or contradicting each other.

claim_a: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma frequently harbors TP53 mutations.
claim_b: Clear cell ovarian carcinoma is associated with chemoresistance and frequent ARID1A mutations.
rationale: Different ovarian carcinoma subtypes and distinct findings.

claim_a: Mallory-Denk bodies are eosinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions seen in alcoholic steatohepatitis.
claim_b: Councilman bodies represent apoptotic hepatocytes commonly observed in viral hepatitis.
rationale: Different inclusion findings in different liver diseases.

claim_a: CD20 expression characterizes most mature B-cell lymphomas and is a target for rituximab therapy.
claim_b: ALK immunohistochemistry highlights anaplastic large cell lymphomas harboring ALK rearrangements.
rationale: Different lymphoma markers and contexts.

claim_a: Mismatch repair deficient colorectal cancers respond favorably to immune checkpoint inhibitors.
claim_b: KRAS exon 2 mutations are detected in roughly 40% of colorectal adenocarcinomas.
rationale: Same disease, but one addresses immunotherapy response and other addresses mutation frequency.

claim_a: Ki-67 proliferation index is used to grade pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors into G1, G2, and G3 categories.
claim_b: Chromogranin A and synaptophysin are standard neuroendocrine markers used in diagnostic confirmation.
rationale: Grading parameter vs diagnostic markers, both for NETs but addressing different questions.

claim_a: Muscularis propria invasion in urothelial carcinoma defines stage pT2 disease.
claim_b: Urothelial carcinoma in situ is characterized by full-thickness cytologic atypia without invasion.
rationale: Staging definition vs in situ description.

claim_a: Ewing sarcoma is defined by EWSR1-FLI1 fusion in the majority of cases.
claim_b: Alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma is associated with PAX3-FOXO1 or PAX7-FOXO1 gene fusions.
rationale: Different sarcoma entities with different fusions.

claim_a: Crescent formation in glomeruli indicates severe glomerular injury and is seen in rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis.
claim_b: Nodular glomerulosclerosis with Kimmelstiel-Wilson lesions is characteristic of diabetic nephropathy.
rationale: Different glomerular pathologies described.

claim_a: Arginase-1 immunohistochemistry shows high sensitivity and specificity for hepatocellular carcinoma differentiation from metastatic adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: Arginase-1 staining reliably distinguishes hepatocellular carcinoma from metastatic adenocarcinomas in the liver.
rationale: Both claims state the same diagnostic utility of Arginase-1 for HCC.

claim_a: MGMT promoter methylation in glioblastoma predicts improved response to temozolomide chemotherapy.
claim_b: Glioblastoma patients whose tumors carry methylated MGMT promoters derive greater benefit from temozolomide treatment.
rationale: Equivalent statements about MGMT methylation and TMZ response.

claim_a: High tumor budding at the invasive front of colorectal carcinoma is associated with adverse prognosis.
claim_b: Increased tumor budding in colorectal cancer correlates with reduced overall survival.
rationale: Both link high tumor budding to worse outcome.

claim_a: Capsular and vascular invasion are required histologic features to diagnose follicular thyroid carcinoma.
claim_b: Definitive diagnosis of follicular thyroid carcinoma depends on identifying invasion through the tumor capsule or into vessels.
rationale: Same diagnostic criterion phrased differently.

claim_a: MYC and BCL2 double-expressor status in DLBCL identifies a subgroup with inferior survival under R-CHOP therapy.
claim_b: DLBCL cases co-expressing MYC and BCL2 proteins respond poorly to standard R-CHOP immunochemotherapy.
rationale: Both describe poorer R-CHOP outcomes in double-expressor DLBCL.

claim_a: Gleason grade group 5 prostate cancer carries the highest risk of biochemical recurrence after radical prostatectomy.
claim_b: Patients with Gleason score 9–10 prostate carcinoma show markedly elevated post-prostatectomy PSA recurrence rates.
rationale: Grade group 5 equals Gleason 9–10; both note highest recurrence.

claim_a: KIT exon 11 mutations in GIST predict good response to imatinib therapy.
claim_b: GISTs harboring exon 11 KIT mutations demonstrate favorable sensitivity to imatinib.
rationale: Direct paraphrase about KIT exon 11 and imatinib response.

claim_a: Lymphovascular invasion in invasive breast carcinoma is an independent predictor of axillary lymph node metastasis.
claim_b: The presence of lymphovascular invasion increases the likelihood of nodal involvement in invasive breast cancer.
rationale: Same association stated equivalently.

claim_a: Loss of BAP1 nuclear expression supports a diagnosis of malignant mesothelioma over reactive mesothelial hyperplasia.
claim_b: BAP1 immunohistochemical loss helps differentiate malignant mesothelioma from benign reactive mesothelial proliferations.
rationale: Equivalent statements on BAP1 utility.

claim_a: High PD-L1 tumor proportion score in NSCLC is associated with improved response to pembrolizumab monotherapy.
claim_b: NSCLC patients with elevated PD-L1 expression show better outcomes when treated with single-agent pembrolizumab.
rationale: Both report better pembrolizumab response with high PD-L1.

claim_a: Perineural invasion in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is associated with shorter overall survival.
claim_b: Perineural invasion does not significantly impact overall survival in resected pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
rationale: Direct contradiction on prognostic impact.

claim_a: CAIX is consistently positive in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
claim_b: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma typically lacks CAIX immunohistochemical expression.
rationale: Opposite claims about CAIX positivity in ccRCC.

claim_a: BRAF V600E mutation in cutaneous melanoma confers sensitivity to vemurafenib treatment.
claim_b: BRAF V600E-mutated cutaneous melanomas are intrinsically resistant to vemurafenib therapy.
rationale: Opposite assertions on vemurafenib sensitivity.

claim_a: FIGO grade 3 endometrioid endometrial carcinoma is associated with higher recurrence risk than grade 1 tumors.
claim_b: FIGO grade has no impact on recurrence risk in endometrioid endometrial carcinoma.
rationale: Conflict on prognostic relevance of FIGO grade.

claim_a: Reed-Sternberg cells in classical Hodgkin lymphoma are typically CD30 and CD15 positive.
claim_b: Reed-Sternberg cells of classical Hodgkin lymphoma characteristically lack CD30 and CD15 expression.
rationale: Conflicting IHC profiles for RS cells.

claim_a: Worst pattern of invasion type 5 in oral squamous cell carcinoma predicts higher risk of locoregional recurrence.
claim_b: Worst pattern of invasion classification does not correlate with recurrence in oral squamous cell carcinoma.
rationale: Contradicts prognostic value of WPOI.

claim_a: WNT-activated medulloblastomas have a favorable prognosis compared with other molecular subgroups.
claim_b: WNT-activated medulloblastoma represents the molecular subgroup with the worst clinical outcome.
rationale: Opposite prognostic statements about WNT subgroup.

claim_a: Aberrant p53 staining is a hallmark of serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma.
claim_b: Serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma typically shows wild-type p53 staining patterns.
rationale: Aberrant vs wild-type p53 are mutually exclusive.

claim_a: Signet ring cell histology in gastric adenocarcinoma is associated with more advanced stage at presentation.
claim_b: Signet ring cell morphology in gastric carcinoma tends to present at earlier stages than intestinal-type tumors.
rationale: Opposing claims on stage at presentation.

claim_a: HER2 amplification in invasive breast carcinoma predicts response to trastuzumab-based therapy.
claim_b: HER2-amplified invasive breast cancers fail to respond to trastuzumab-containing regimens.
rationale: Opposite claims about trastuzumab efficacy.

claim_a: MDM2 immunohistochemistry assists in identifying well-differentiated liposarcoma in fatty soft tissue lesions.
claim_b: SOX10 expression is characteristic of schwannomas and melanocytic lesions.
rationale: Different IHC markers and different tumor types.

claim_a: EWSR1-FLI1 fusion is the defining molecular alteration of Ewing sarcoma.
claim_b: SS18-SSX fusions characterize synovial sarcoma at the molecular level.
rationale: Different sarcoma entities with different fusions.

claim_a: Variant histology in muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma is associated with worse prognosis.
claim_b: FGFR3 mutations are frequent in low-grade papillary urothelial neoplasms.
rationale: Same organ but different findings/outcomes.

claim_a: Mallory-Denk bodies are intracytoplasmic hyaline inclusions seen in alcoholic steatohepatitis.
claim_b: Councilman bodies represent apoptotic hepatocytes commonly seen in viral hepatitis.
rationale: Different liver inclusions/contexts.

claim_a: Ki-67 proliferation index above 20% defines grade 3 pancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms.
claim_b: Chromogranin A is a sensitive immunohistochemical marker of neuroendocrine differentiation.
rationale: Same family but unrelated assertions (grading vs marker).

claim_a: TTF-1 positivity supports a pulmonary origin in adenocarcinomas of unknown primary.
claim_b: Napsin A staining is generally lost in pulmonary squamous cell carcinomas.
rationale: Two distinct IHC observations in lung context.

claim_a: KRAS mutation status predicts resistance to anti-EGFR therapy in metastatic colorectal carcinoma.
claim_b: Mismatch repair deficiency in colorectal carcinoma confers susceptibility to immune checkpoint inhibitors.
rationale: Same disease but different biomarkers/therapies.

claim_a: Depth of stromal invasion is a key parameter for staging early cervical squamous cell carcinoma.
claim_b: HPV 16 and 18 are the most prevalent high-risk types associated with cervical carcinogenesis.
rationale: Staging criterion vs etiology, both cervical cancer.

claim_a: FLT3-ITD mutations confer poor prognosis in acute myeloid leukemia.
claim_b: BCR-ABL1 fusion defines chronic myeloid leukemia and a subset of B-ALL.
rationale: Different leukemias and different alterations.

claim_a: Basal cell carcinoma typically shows peripheral palisading and retraction artifact on histology.
claim_b: Acantholysis is the characteristic histologic feature of pemphigus vulgaris.
rationale: Different dermatopathology entities.

claim_a: Hürthle cell neoplasms are composed of follicular cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm rich in mitochondria.
claim_b: Oncocytic thyroid tumours show large polygonal cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm reflecting mitochondrial accumulation.
rationale: Both describe the same defining cytologic feature of Hürthle/oncocytic thyroid lesions.

claim_a: Most GISTs express CD117 (KIT) by immunohistochemistry, supporting the diagnosis in spindle cell mesenchymal gastric tumours.
claim_b: CD117 positivity is observed in the majority of gastrointestinal stromal tumours and aids their distinction from leiomyomas.
rationale: Both convey that CD117 is a positive marker in most GISTs.

claim_a: TERT promoter mutations are frequent in IDH-wildtype glioblastoma and contribute to telomerase reactivation.
claim_b: In IDH-wildtype glioblastomas, telomerase activation is commonly driven by mutations in the TERT promoter region.
rationale: Both state TERT promoter mutation drives telomerase activation in IDH-wildtype GBM.

claim_a: Tumour budding at the invasive front is associated with adverse prognosis in stage II colorectal cancer.
claim_b: High-grade tumour budding identifies stage II colorectal carcinomas with increased risk of recurrence and worse outcome.
rationale: Both link tumour budding to adverse outcome in stage II CRC.

claim_a: HER2-amplified breast carcinomas show improved disease-free survival when treated with adjuvant trastuzumab.
claim_b: Trastuzumab adjuvant therapy reduces recurrence rates in patients with HER2-overexpressing invasive breast carcinoma.
rationale: Both describe trastuzumab benefit in HER2+ breast cancer.

claim_a: Gleason pattern 5 includes sheets of tumour cells without gland formation and indicates aggressive prostatic carcinoma.
claim_b: In prostate cancer, Gleason pattern 5 is characterised by absent glandular differentiation and is associated with poor prognosis.
rationale: Both describe Gleason 5 morphology and prognostic implication.

claim_a: Breslow thickness greater than 4 mm corresponds to pT4 stage in cutaneous melanoma per AJCC guidelines.
claim_b: Cutaneous melanomas with Breslow depth exceeding 4 mm are classified as pT4 lesions under the AJCC staging system.
rationale: Both restate the AJCC pT4 cut-off for melanoma.

claim_a: The Hans algorithm uses CD10, BCL6 and MUM1 to classify DLBCL into germinal centre B-cell and non-germinal centre subtypes.
claim_b: Immunohistochemical staining with CD10, BCL6 and MUM1 enables Hans classification of DLBCL into GCB and non-GCB groups.
rationale: Both describe the Hans IHC algorithm for DLBCL.

claim_a: POLE ultramutated endometrial carcinomas display an extremely high tumour mutational burden and favourable outcomes.
claim_b: Endometrial cancers harbouring POLE exonuclease domain mutations show excellent prognosis despite high-grade histology.
rationale: Both indicate favourable prognosis of POLE-mutant endometrial carcinomas.

claim_a: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma is characterised by scattered Reed-Sternberg cells within a mixed inflammatory background.
claim_b: The hallmark of classic Hodgkin lymphoma is the presence of Reed-Sternberg cells embedded in a reactive inflammatory infiltrate.
rationale: Both restate the defining morphology of classic HL.

claim_a: Perineural invasion in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is associated with worse overall survival.
claim_b: Perineural invasion in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma has no significant impact on overall survival outcomes.
rationale: Directly opposing claims about prognostic value of perineural invasion.

disease_or_entity: renal cell carcinoma, clear cell type
claim_a: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma typically shows strong diffuse positivity for CAIX by immunohistochemistry.
claim_b: CAIX is characteristically negative in clear cell renal cell carcinoma, limiting its diagnostic usefulness.
rationale: Opposite IHC findings for CAIX in ccRCC.

claim_a: WNT-activated medulloblastomas carry a favourable prognosis compared with other molecular subgroups.
claim_b: WNT-activated medulloblastomas show the poorest survival outcomes among molecular subgroups of medulloblastoma.
rationale: Opposite prognostic claims about WNT subgroup.

claim_a: BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic melanomas respond favourably to BRAF inhibitor therapy.
claim_b: BRAF V600E mutation in metastatic melanoma confers resistance to BRAF inhibitor treatment.
rationale: Opposite assertions about BRAF inhibitor response.

claim_a: High nuclear grade DCIS exhibits marked nuclear pleomorphism and frequent comedo-type necrosis.
claim_b: High nuclear grade DCIS shows uniform small nuclei without necrosis or significant pleomorphism.
rationale: Mutually exclusive descriptions of high-grade DCIS morphology.

claim_a: Lymph node metastasis is a strong independent predictor of poor outcome in gastric adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: Lymph node involvement does not independently predict prognosis in gastric adenocarcinoma after stage adjustment.
rationale: Direct contradiction about prognostic independence of nodal metastasis.

claim_a: Capsular and/or vascular invasion is required for the diagnosis of follicular thyroid carcinoma.
claim_b: Follicular thyroid carcinoma can be diagnosed in the absence of capsular or vascular invasion when nuclear features are present.
rationale: Conflicting diagnostic criteria for FTC.

claim_a: Loss of BAP1 nuclear expression supports a diagnosis of malignant mesothelioma over reactive mesothelial proliferation.
claim_b: BAP1 nuclear expression is retained in malignant mesothelioma and is therefore not useful in distinguishing it from reactive mesothelium.
rationale: Opposite claims about BAP1 utility in mesothelioma diagnosis.

claim_a: The BCR-ABL1 fusion resulting from t(9;22) is the defining molecular abnormality of chronic myeloid leukaemia.
claim_b: Chronic myeloid leukaemia is characterised by the absence of BCR-ABL1 fusion, which is found in other myeloid neoplasms.
rationale: Direct contradiction on BCR-ABL1 presence in CML.

claim_a: BRCA1/2 mutation in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma is associated with improved response to platinum chemotherapy.
claim_b: BRCA1/2 mutations in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma predict poor response to platinum-based therapy.
rationale: Opposing claims about BRCA and platinum sensitivity.

claim_a: Glypican-3 is frequently expressed in hepatocellular carcinoma and supports its distinction from benign hepatocellular lesions.
claim_b: TTF-1 nuclear staining is a sensitive marker for lung adenocarcinoma in metastatic workups.
rationale: Different tumours and different markers.

claim_a: Sessile serrated lesions show crypt dilation and basal serration in the colonic mucosa.
claim_b: Lichen planus shows a band-like lymphocytic infiltrate at the dermoepidermal junction with basal vacuolar change.
rationale: Different organ systems and pathologies.

claim_a: Ewing sarcoma typically harbours the EWSR1-FLI1 fusion arising from t(11;22).
claim_b: Synovial sarcoma is characterised by the SS18-SSX fusion gene resulting from t(X;18).
rationale: Different sarcomas with different translocations; not contradictory.

claim_a: PD-L1 high expression in non-small cell lung cancer correlates with improved response to immune checkpoint inhibitors.
claim_b: Lymphovascular invasion is an adverse prognostic factor in upper tract urothelial carcinoma.
rationale: Different cancers and different prognostic factors.

claim_a: Patients with 17p deletion in chronic lymphocytic leukaemia show reduced response to standard chemoimmunotherapy.
claim_b: MSI-high colorectal cancers demonstrate improved response to PD-1 blockade compared with microsatellite stable tumours.
rationale: Different diseases and therapies.

claim_a: Stromal invasion depth greater than 5 mm in cervical squamous cell carcinoma corresponds to stage IB under FIGO 2018.
claim_b: Tumour size greater than 7 cm in renal cell carcinoma confined to the kidney is classified as pT2 disease.
rationale: Different organ staging systems.

claim_a: Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours are graded based on mitotic count and Ki-67 proliferation index per WHO criteria.
claim_b: Fuhrman/ISUP grading of clear cell renal cell carcinoma is based on nucleolar prominence at defined magnifications.
rationale: Different grading systems for different tumours.

claim_a: MDM2 amplification detected by FISH supports the diagnosis of well-differentiated liposarcoma over benign lipoma.
claim_b: INI1 (SMARCB1) loss is a defining immunohistochemical feature of epithelioid sarcoma.
rationale: Both about soft tissue tumours but different entities and markers.

claim_a: Membranous nephropathy demonstrates diffuse thickening of glomerular capillary walls with subepithelial immune deposits.
claim_b: IgA nephropathy shows mesangial proliferation with predominant IgA deposition on immunofluorescence.
rationale: Both glomerular diseases but distinct entities and findings.

claim_a: FLT3-ITD mutations in acute myeloid leukaemia are associated with adverse risk and shorter remission duration.
claim_b: EGFR exon 19 deletions in lung adenocarcinoma predict response to tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy.
rationale: Different cancers and different molecular alterations.

claim_a: IDH1 R132H mutation is present in the majority of grade 2 and 3 diffuse astrocytomas in adults.
claim_b: Most adult diffuse astrocytomas of grade 2 or 3 harbor an IDH1 R132H mutation.
rationale: Both sentences state the same prevalence relationship in equivalent wording.

claim_a: DOG1 immunostaining is positive in nearly all gastrointestinal stromal tumors, including KIT-negative cases.
claim_b: DOG1 is a sensitive marker for gastrointestinal stromal tumor and remains positive in many KIT-negative tumors.
rationale: Equivalent assertions about DOG1 sensitivity in GIST.

claim_a: High stromal tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes are associated with improved overall survival in triple-negative breast cancer.
claim_b: Increased TIL density in the stroma predicts better outcome for patients with triple-negative breast carcinoma.
rationale: Same prognostic direction with different phrasing.

claim_a: Reed-Sternberg cells in classical Hodgkin lymphoma are typically large with bilobed nuclei and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli.
claim_b: Classical Hodgkin lymphoma shows binucleated neoplastic cells with large inclusion-like nucleoli, characteristic of Reed-Sternberg morphology.
rationale: Both describe the same Reed-Sternberg morphology.

claim_a: HER2 amplification predicts response to trastuzumab-based therapy in invasive breast carcinoma.
claim_b: Patients with HER2-amplified breast cancer benefit from anti-HER2 monoclonal antibody treatment.
rationale: Both state HER2 amplification predicts benefit from anti-HER2 therapy.

claim_a: Lymphovascular invasion in colorectal adenocarcinoma is associated with higher risk of nodal metastasis.
claim_b: Tumors demonstrating lymphovascular invasion more frequently present with regional lymph node involvement in colorectal cancer.
rationale: Same association expressed with different syntax.

claim_a: Synovial sarcoma is characterized by the t(X;18) translocation producing the SS18-SSX fusion gene.
claim_b: The SS18-SSX fusion resulting from t(X;18)(p11;q11) is the defining molecular event of synovial sarcoma.
rationale: Same defining translocation described.

claim_a: Gleason pattern 4 includes cribriform glandular architecture without single-cell infiltration.
claim_b: Cribriform glands lacking necrosis are graded as Gleason pattern 4 in prostate adenocarcinoma.
rationale: Both identify cribriform architecture as pattern 4.

claim_a: SOX10 is a sensitive nuclear marker expressed in most melanomas, including spindle cell and desmoplastic variants.
claim_b: SOX10 immunohistochemistry reliably labels desmoplastic melanoma and other melanocytic neoplasms.
rationale: Both claims agree on SOX10 sensitivity including desmoplastic melanoma.

claim_a: Sarcomatoid differentiation in clear cell renal cell carcinoma is associated with poor prognosis.
claim_b: The presence of sarcomatoid features in clear cell RCC portends aggressive clinical behavior and reduced survival.
rationale: Both state sarcomatoid features confer poor prognosis.

claim_a: Calretinin shows diffuse nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity in epithelioid mesothelioma.
claim_b: Epithelioid mesothelioma is typically negative for calretinin on immunohistochemistry.
rationale: Directly opposite claims about calretinin expression.

claim_a: BRAF V600E mutation in metastatic colorectal cancer is associated with poor response to anti-EGFR therapy.
claim_b: BRAF V600E mutated metastatic colorectal carcinomas respond well to anti-EGFR monoclonal antibodies.
rationale: Opposite predictions about anti-EGFR response.

claim_a: MYC and BCL2 double-expression in DLBCL is associated with inferior overall survival.
claim_b: Co-expression of MYC and BCL2 has no prognostic impact in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
rationale: One asserts adverse outcome; the other denies any prognostic effect.

claim_a: Capsular and/or vascular invasion is required for the diagnosis of follicular thyroid carcinoma.
claim_b: Follicular thyroid carcinoma can be diagnosed in the absence of capsular or vascular invasion based on cytologic features alone.
rationale: Conflicting diagnostic criteria for FTC.

claim_a: Small cell lung carcinoma typically shows strong diffuse TTF-1 positivity and synaptophysin expression.
claim_b: Small cell lung carcinoma is characteristically negative for both TTF-1 and synaptophysin.
rationale: Opposite IHC patterns for SCLC.

claim_a: FIGO grading of endometrioid carcinoma is based on the percentage of solid non-squamous growth.
claim_b: FIGO grading of endometrioid endometrial carcinoma depends primarily on mitotic count and ignores architectural pattern.
rationale: Conflicting accounts of the FIGO grading basis.

claim_a: High PD-L1 expression in metastatic melanoma correlates with improved response to PD-1 checkpoint inhibitors.
claim_b: PD-L1 expression status does not correlate with response to PD-1 blockade in metastatic melanoma.
rationale: Opposite claims about predictive value of PD-L1.

claim_a: Supratentorial ependymomas frequently harbor ZFTA (C11orf95)-RELA fusions.
claim_b: ZFTA-RELA fusions are not found in supratentorial ependymomas and are restricted to spinal tumors.
rationale: Conflicting molecular localization claims.

claim_a: Perineural invasion in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is an independent predictor of decreased survival.
claim_b: Perineural invasion in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma does not independently affect survival outcomes.
rationale: Direct negation of prognostic significance.

claim_a: Breslow thickness is the most important prognostic factor for primary cutaneous melanoma staging.
claim_b: Breslow depth has been replaced as the primary prognostic factor by Clark level in melanoma staging.
rationale: Conflicting claims about the primary staging variable.

claim_a: CD138 immunostaining highlights plasma cells in bone marrow biopsies and is useful for quantifying plasma cell infiltration.
claim_b: Cyclin D1 immunoreactivity is characteristic of mantle cell lymphoma and correlates with t(11;14) translocation.
rationale: Different markers and different diseases.

claim_a: MGMT promoter methylation predicts improved response to temozolomide in glioblastoma.
claim_b: 1p/19q codeletion is a defining feature of oligodendroglioma and confers chemosensitivity.
rationale: Related field but different tumor and alteration.

claim_a: Helicobacter pylori organisms are visualized as curved bacilli on the surface epithelium of antral mucosa.
claim_b: Intestinal metaplasia in Barrett esophagus is recognized by the presence of goblet cells.
rationale: Different organs and different findings.

claim_a: High Ki-67 proliferation index is associated with worse prognosis in luminal breast cancer.
claim_b: E-cadherin loss is a characteristic feature of invasive lobular carcinoma of the breast.
rationale: Both are about breast cancer but address different questions.

claim_a: High-grade urothelial carcinoma shows marked nuclear pleomorphism and loss of polarity.
claim_b: Papillary urothelial neoplasm of low malignant potential has a low recurrence rate after resection.
rationale: Same organ system but unrelated assertions.

claim_a: EGFR exon 19 deletions in lung adenocarcinoma predict sensitivity to tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
claim_b: ALK rearrangements are found in approximately 5% of lung adenocarcinomas.
rationale: Both involve NSCLC but distinct alterations and outcomes.

claim_a: MDM2 amplification by FISH supports the diagnosis of well-differentiated liposarcoma.
claim_b: STAT6 nuclear positivity is characteristic of solitary fibrous tumor.
rationale: Different soft tissue tumors and different markers.

claim_a: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma frequently harbors TP53 mutations.
claim_b: Endometrial clear cell carcinoma is associated with ARID1A loss.
rationale: Related gynecologic malignancies with distinct genetic alterations.

claim_a: Amyloid deposits in cardiac tissue appear as apple-green birefringent material under polarized light after Congo red staining.
claim_b: Cytokeratin AE1/AE3 immunostaining highlights epithelial cells in carcinoma diagnosis.
rationale: Completely unrelated topics.

claim_a: Signet ring cell carcinoma of the stomach often presents at an advanced stage with diffuse mural infiltration.
claim_b: Hepatocellular carcinoma is staged using the Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer system incorporating tumor burden and liver function.
rationale: Different GI cancers and different staging systems.

disease_or_entity: signet ring cell carcinoma of stomach
claim_a: Signet ring cell carcinoma of the stomach is characterized by intracytoplasmic mucin displacing the nucleus peripherally.
claim_b: Gastric signet ring cell carcinoma shows mucin-filled cytoplasm that pushes the nucleus to the cell periphery.
rationale: Both describe identical morphological feature using different wording.

claim_a: Most gastrointestinal stromal tumors demonstrate diffuse cytoplasmic positivity for KIT (CD117) on immunohistochemistry.
claim_b: CD117 immunostaining is positive in the majority of GISTs and supports the diagnosis.
rationale: Both state CD117 positivity in GIST.

claim_a: Oligodendrogliomas are defined molecularly by IDH mutation and 1p/19q codeletion.
claim_b: The diagnosis of oligodendroglioma requires demonstration of both IDH mutation and combined 1p/19q loss.
rationale: Both describe defining molecular criteria.

claim_a: High tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte density in triple-negative breast cancer is associated with improved disease-free survival.
claim_b: Elevated TIL counts in TNBC correlate with better recurrence-free outcomes.
rationale: Both link high TILs with better outcomes in TNBC.

claim_a: HER2 overexpression in gastric adenocarcinoma predicts response to trastuzumab-based therapy.
claim_b: Gastric cancers with HER2 amplification benefit from anti-HER2 targeted treatment.
rationale: Both assert HER2-positive gastric cancer responds to HER2-targeted therapy.

claim_a: Gleason pattern 5 prostate cancer includes solid sheets, cords, or single cells without gland formation.
claim_b: Lack of glandular differentiation with single cells or solid nests defines Gleason pattern 5.
rationale: Both define Gleason 5 morphology.

claim_a: Lymph node metastasis in colorectal carcinoma upstages the tumor to at least stage III disease.
claim_b: Regional nodal involvement places colorectal cancer into AJCC stage III regardless of T category.
rationale: Both convey node-positive CRC is stage III.

claim_a: HepPar-1 and arginase-1 immunostains help confirm hepatocellular differentiation in liver tumors.
claim_b: Arginase-1 positivity together with HepPar-1 staining supports a hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosis.
rationale: Both describe IHC markers confirming HCC.

claim_a: Ewing sarcoma harbors EWSR1-FLI1 fusion in the majority of cases.
claim_b: Most Ewing sarcomas are driven by a translocation fusing EWSR1 to FLI1.
rationale: Both describe characteristic Ewing fusion.

claim_a: MYC and BCL2 double-hit DLBCL carries a worse prognosis than non-rearranged DLBCL.
claim_b: Concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements in DLBCL are linked to inferior survival.
rationale: Both indicate double-hit DLBCL has worse outcome.

claim_a: Synovial sarcoma typically shows strong nuclear TLE1 staining by immunohistochemistry.
claim_b: TLE1 nuclear expression is absent in synovial sarcoma and cannot aid diagnosis.
rationale: Direct contradiction about TLE1 staining.

claim_a: High nuclear grade in clear cell renal cell carcinoma is associated with worse cancer-specific survival.
claim_b: Nuclear grade has no prognostic impact on survival in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
rationale: Opposing claims on grade prognostic value.

claim_a: BRAF V600E mutations are present in roughly half of cutaneous melanomas.
claim_b: BRAF V600E mutations are rarely encountered in cutaneous melanoma.
rationale: Opposite assertions about BRAF frequency.

claim_a: Microsatellite-instability-high colorectal cancers respond favorably to immune checkpoint inhibitors.
claim_b: MSI-high colorectal tumors are resistant to immune checkpoint blockade therapy.
rationale: Direct contradiction on immunotherapy response.

claim_a: Follicular thyroid carcinoma is distinguished from adenoma by capsular or vascular invasion.
claim_b: Capsular and vascular invasion are not required to distinguish follicular carcinoma from adenoma.
rationale: Opposing definitions of FTC criteria.

claim_a: Calretinin positivity favors mesothelioma over pulmonary adenocarcinoma in pleural biopsies.
claim_b: Calretinin staining is more typical of pulmonary adenocarcinoma than mesothelioma.
rationale: Reversed marker associations.

claim_a: High nuclear grade DCIS shows pronounced pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli, and frequent mitoses.
claim_b: High-grade DCIS displays uniform small nuclei with inconspicuous nucleoli and rare mitoses.
rationale: Conflicting descriptions of high-grade DCIS.

claim_a: Increasing Breslow thickness in cutaneous melanoma correlates with rising risk of metastasis.
claim_b: Breslow thickness shows no relationship with metastatic risk in cutaneous melanoma.
rationale: Contradictory statements about Breslow.

claim_a: TP53 mutations are characteristic of serous endometrial carcinoma.
claim_b: Serous endometrial carcinomas typically lack TP53 mutations.
rationale: Opposite molecular claims.

disease_or_entity: PD-L1 in non-small cell lung cancer
claim_a: High PD-L1 expression in NSCLC predicts better response to pembrolizumab monotherapy.
claim_b: PD-L1 high expression in NSCLC fails to predict pembrolizumab efficacy.
rationale: Direct contradiction on predictive value.

claim_a: Glioblastoma shows microvascular proliferation and pseudopalisading necrosis on histology.
claim_b: Schwannomas demonstrate Antoni A and Antoni B areas with Verocay bodies.
rationale: Different tumor entities.

claim_a: GATA3 is a useful marker for confirming breast origin in metastatic carcinoma of unknown primary.
claim_b: CDX2 highlights intestinal differentiation in adenocarcinomas of gastrointestinal origin.
rationale: Different markers for different sites.

claim_a: BCR-ABL1 fusion from t(9;22) defines chronic myeloid leukemia.
claim_b: PML-RARA fusion is the hallmark of acute promyelocytic leukemia.
rationale: Different leukemias with different fusions.

claim_a: Perineural invasion in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is linked to poorer overall survival.
claim_b: Tumor budding in colorectal cancer is associated with reduced disease-free survival.
rationale: Different tumors and features.

claim_a: EGFR exon 19 deletions in lung adenocarcinoma predict response to osimertinib.
claim_b: ALK rearrangements in lung adenocarcinoma are targeted by alectinib therapy.
rationale: Different driver alterations and drugs.

claim_a: Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors are graded using Ki-67 proliferation index and mitotic count.
claim_b: Squamous cell carcinoma of the lung is graded by keratinization and intercellular bridges.
rationale: Different grading schemes for different tumors.

claim_a: Muscularis propria invasion in urothelial carcinoma corresponds to at least pT2 disease.
claim_b: Lymphovascular invasion in cervical carcinoma is documented as an independent risk factor.
rationale: Different organ staging discussions.

claim_a: Duodenal biopsies in celiac disease show villous blunting and intraepithelial lymphocytosis.
claim_b: Crohn disease ileal biopsies often demonstrate non-caseating granulomas and transmural inflammation.
rationale: Different GI conditions.

claim_a: Loss of basal cell markers p63 and high-molecular-weight cytokeratin supports invasive prostate carcinoma.
claim_b: SOX10 nuclear expression is helpful for confirming melanocytic differentiation in skin tumors.
rationale: Different organ IHC panels.

claim_a: WNT-activated medulloblastomas carry a favorable prognosis compared to other molecular subgroups.
claim_b: SDH-deficient gastrointestinal stromal tumors frequently arise in younger patients with multifocal disease.
rationale: Unrelated tumors and biology.

claim_a: IDH1 R132H mutation is detected in the majority of WHO grade 2 and 3 astrocytomas in adults.
claim_b: Most adult diffuse astrocytomas of WHO grade 2 or 3 harbor an IDH1 R132H point mutation.
rationale: Both claims state the same prevalence of IDH1 R132H in adult lower-grade astrocytomas.

claim_a: DOG1 immunostaining is positive in nearly all gastrointestinal stromal tumors, including KIT-negative cases.
claim_b: DOG1 expression by immunohistochemistry highlights GIST even when CD117 staining is absent.
rationale: Both describe DOG1 sensitivity in GIST including KIT/CD117-negative cases.

claim_a: High tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte density in triple-negative breast cancer is associated with improved disease-free survival.
claim_b: In triple-negative breast carcinomas, increased stromal TILs correlate with better recurrence-free outcomes.
rationale: Same direction of association between TILs and survival in TNBC.

claim_a: Medullary thyroid carcinoma typically shows nests of polygonal cells embedded in amyloid stroma.
claim_b: Amyloid deposition within a nested polygonal cell proliferation is characteristic of medullary carcinoma of the thyroid.
rationale: Equivalent morphologic descriptions.

claim_a: Trastuzumab-based therapy improves overall survival in HER2-overexpressing advanced gastric adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: Patients with HER2-positive metastatic gastric cancer derive a survival benefit from addition of trastuzumab to chemotherapy.
rationale: Both report survival benefit of trastuzumab in HER2+ gastric cancer.

claim_a: Cribriform architecture in prostate adenocarcinoma is incorporated into Gleason pattern 4.
claim_b: Gleason grading classifies cribriform glandular growth as pattern 4 in prostatic adenocarcinoma.
rationale: Both state cribriform = Gleason 4.

claim_a: Synovial sarcoma harbors a recurrent t(X;18) translocation producing an SS18-SSX fusion transcript.
claim_b: The SS18-SSX gene fusion resulting from t(X;18)(p11;q11) is the defining molecular alteration of synovial sarcoma.
rationale: Same fusion described with additional cytogenetic detail.

claim_a: Calretinin and WT1 positivity supports a diagnosis of epithelioid mesothelioma over pulmonary adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: Mesothelial origin is favored when tumor cells express both calretinin and WT1 in a serosal-based neoplasm.
rationale: Both indicate the same IHC profile favors mesothelioma.

claim_a: Tumor invasion through the muscularis propria into pericolorectal tissues defines pT3 in colorectal carcinoma.
claim_b: In AJCC staging of colon cancer, pT3 describes extension beyond the muscularis propria into pericolic adipose tissue.
rationale: Equivalent T3 definitions.

claim_a: Reed-Sternberg cells in classic Hodgkin lymphoma typically express CD30 and CD15 but lack CD45.
claim_b: The neoplastic cells of classic Hodgkin lymphoma show a CD30+/CD15+/CD45- immunophenotype.
rationale: Same immunophenotype of HRS cells.

claim_a: SMAD4 loss in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma correlates with widespread metastatic disease at autopsy.
claim_b: Retained SMAD4 expression in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is associated with widespread metastatic spread.
rationale: Opposite SMAD4 status linked to the same outcome.

claim_a: MYC protein overexpression by IHC predicts worse overall survival in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
claim_b: MYC immunohistochemical positivity has no prognostic impact on overall survival in DLBCL.
rationale: Direct negation regarding prognostic value of MYC IHC.

claim_a: POLE-ultramutated endometrial carcinomas are associated with excellent prognosis despite high-grade morphology.
claim_b: POLE-mutated endometrial cancers exhibit poor outcomes even when of low-grade histology.
rationale: Opposite prognostic claim for POLE-mutated endometrial carcinoma.

claim_a: Capsular and vascular invasion are required histologic features to diagnose follicular thyroid carcinoma.
claim_b: Follicular thyroid carcinoma can be diagnosed in the absence of any capsular or vascular invasion.
rationale: Diagnostic criteria directly oppose.

claim_a: KRAS-mutant metastatic colorectal cancers respond well to anti-EGFR monoclonal antibody therapy.
claim_b: KRAS mutations confer resistance to anti-EGFR antibody therapy in metastatic colorectal carcinoma.
rationale: Opposite direction of treatment response by KRAS status.

claim_a: Brain parenchymal invasion alone is sufficient to classify a meningioma as WHO grade 2.
claim_b: Brain invasion in meningiomas does not by itself elevate the tumor to WHO grade 2.
rationale: Opposing statements about brain invasion and grading.

claim_a: CA9 shows diffuse membranous staining in clear cell renal cell carcinoma in nearly all cases.
claim_b: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma generally lacks CA9 expression by immunohistochemistry.
rationale: Opposite CA9 expression claims in ccRCC.

claim_a: Increasing Breslow thickness in cutaneous melanoma correlates with worse disease-specific survival.
claim_b: Breslow thickness does not influence disease-specific survival in patients with cutaneous melanoma.
rationale: Direct negation of prognostic impact of Breslow thickness.

claim_a: Codeletion of chromosomes 1p and 19q is a defining molecular feature of oligodendroglioma.
claim_b: Oligodendrogliomas characteristically retain intact 1p and 19q chromosomes.
rationale: Opposing claims about 1p/19q status in oligodendroglioma.

claim_a: Comedonecrosis within ductal carcinoma in situ is associated with high nuclear grade.
claim_b: Comedo-type necrosis in DCIS is typically seen in lesions with low nuclear grade.
rationale: Opposite association between comedonecrosis and nuclear grade.

claim_a: Synaptophysin is a sensitive marker for neuroendocrine differentiation in well-differentiated tumors.
claim_b: Calretinin staining helps distinguish mesothelioma from peritoneal adenocarcinoma.
rationale: Different markers and tumor contexts.

claim_a: EGFR exon 19 deletions predict response to tyrosine kinase inhibitors in lung adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: BRAF V600E mutation defines a subset of papillary thyroid carcinomas with infiltrative growth.
rationale: Different genes and tumors.

claim_a: Microvascular invasion in hepatocellular carcinoma is associated with increased post-transplant recurrence.
claim_b: Eosinophilic infiltration in esophageal mucosa is characteristic of eosinophilic esophagitis.
rationale: Unrelated diseases and findings.

claim_a: Helicobacter pylori organisms are best identified on the surface mucous layer of antral mucosa.
claim_b: Psammoma bodies are frequently observed within papillary thyroid carcinomas.
rationale: Different organs and findings.

claim_a: Invasion into the muscularis propria of the bladder defines pT2 urothelial carcinoma.
claim_b: Lynch syndrome is associated with germline mutations in mismatch repair genes such as MLH1.
rationale: Staging vs hereditary syndrome topics.

claim_a: Loss of basal cell markers p63 and high-molecular-weight cytokeratin supports a diagnosis of invasive prostatic adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: PAX8 expression is useful in confirming a Müllerian or renal origin of metastatic carcinoma.
rationale: Different IHC markers for different diagnostic contexts.

claim_a: BCR-ABL1 tyrosine kinase inhibitors induce durable molecular responses in chronic-phase CML.
claim_b: Tumor PD-L1 expression by IHC is used to select patients with NSCLC for checkpoint blockade.
rationale: Two distinct therapeutic biomarker contexts.

claim_a: Duodenal biopsies in celiac disease show villous blunting and intraepithelial lymphocytosis.
claim_b: Granulomas in lymph nodes draining a lung lesion may indicate sarcoidosis or infection.
rationale: Different organs and diseases.

claim_a: EWSR1-FLI1 fusion transcripts are diagnostic of Ewing sarcoma in small round cell tumors of bone.
claim_b: Microsatellite instability testing identifies a subset of colorectal carcinomas with mismatch repair deficiency.
rationale: Distinct molecular assays and tumor types.

claim_a: BRCA1/2 mutation status influences response to PARP inhibitor therapy in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma.
claim_b: Perineural invasion in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma correlates with local recurrence after resection.
rationale: Both prognostic, but different tumors and biomarkers.

disease_or_entity: signet ring cell carcinoma of stomach
claim_a: Signet ring cell gastric carcinoma is characterized by intracytoplasmic mucin displacing the nucleus to the cell periphery.
claim_b: In signet ring cell gastric carcinoma, abundant cytoplasmic mucin compresses the nucleus against the cell membrane.
rationale: Both describe the same defining morphologic feature.

claim_a: Most gastrointestinal stromal tumors show diffuse cytoplasmic positivity for KIT (CD117) on immunohistochemistry.
claim_b: DOG1 immunostaining is positive in the majority of gastrointestinal stromal tumors, including KIT-negative cases.
rationale: Both support the IHC profile of GIST; DOG1 elaborates beyond KIT.

claim_a: Oligodendrogliomas are defined by combined whole-arm losses of chromosomes 1p and 19q together with IDH mutation.
claim_b: The diagnosis of oligodendroglioma requires both IDH mutation and 1p/19q codeletion under current WHO criteria.
rationale: Equivalent statements of molecular definition.

claim_a: High tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte density in triple-negative breast cancer is associated with improved disease-free survival.
claim_b: Elevated stromal TIL counts confer a favorable prognosis in patients with triple-negative breast carcinoma.
rationale: Same prognostic direction for TILs in TNBC.

claim_a: Mismatch repair deficient colorectal carcinomas show high response rates to immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
claim_b: MSI-high colorectal cancers exhibit durable clinical benefit from anti-PD-1 immunotherapy.
rationale: MMR-deficient and MSI-high describe the same group with the same response.

claim_a: A Gleason score of 4+3=7 carries a worse prognosis than a Gleason score of 3+4=7 in prostate adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: Prostate cancers with predominant Gleason pattern 4 (4+3) have higher rates of biochemical recurrence than those with predominant pattern 3 (3+4).
rationale: Both express the same prognostic gradient within Gleason 7.
