claim_a: Breslow thickness is the strongest histologic predictor of outcome in primary cutaneous melanoma.
claim_b: Tumor thickness measured by the Breslow method is the most important prognostic histopathologic parameter in primary melanoma.
rationale: Identical claim about Breslow's prognostic role.

claim_a: HepPar-1, arginase-1, and glypican-3 form a useful immunohistochemical panel for confirming hepatocellular carcinoma.
claim_b: Arginase-1 immunostaining is a sensitive and specific marker for hepatocellular differentiation in liver tumors.
rationale: Both support arginase-1's diagnostic value in HCC.

claim_a: Classical Hodgkin lymphoma is characterized by scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a reactive inflammatory background.
claim_b: In classical Hodgkin lymphoma, neoplastic Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are sparse and embedded in a mixed inflammatory infiltrate.
rationale: Same morphologic description.

claim_a: Ewing sarcoma typically harbors an EWSR1-FLI1 fusion resulting from t(11;22)(q24;q12).
claim_b: The t(11;22) translocation producing EWSR1-FLI1 is the most common molecular event in Ewing sarcoma.
rationale: Equivalent molecular descriptions.

claim_a: Small cell lung carcinoma typically shows diffuse positivity for synaptophysin and chromogranin A.
claim_b: Small cell lung carcinoma is consistently negative for neuroendocrine markers including synaptophysin and chromogranin.
rationale: Direct contradiction about neuroendocrine marker expression.

claim_a: MYC and BCL2 double-expressor diffuse large B-cell lymphomas have inferior overall survival compared to non-double-expressors.
claim_b: Co-expression of MYC and BCL2 proteins does not significantly affect overall survival in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
rationale: Opposite claims regarding prognostic impact.

claim_a: MGMT promoter methylation predicts improved response to temozolomide therapy in glioblastoma.
claim_b: MGMT promoter methylation status has no predictive value for temozolomide benefit in glioblastoma patients.
rationale: Direct contradiction of predictive value.

claim_a: Higher Nottingham histologic grade in invasive ductal carcinoma correlates with worse disease-specific survival.
claim_b: Nottingham grade shows no significant association with disease-specific survival in invasive ductal breast carcinoma.
rationale: Contradicts the prognostic association.

claim_a: EGFR exon 19 deletions predict sensitivity to first-line tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy in lung adenocarcinoma.
claim_b: EGFR exon 19 deletions are associated with primary resistance to EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors in lung adenocarcinoma.
rationale: Opposite directional claims about TKI response.

claim_a: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma characteristically shows diffuse CA9 membranous staining by immunohistochemistry.
claim_b: Clear cell renal cell carcinomas are typically negative for CA9 on immunohistochemistry.
rationale: Opposite IHC findings.

claim_a: Capsular and/or vascular invasion is required to distinguish follicular thyroid carcinoma from follicular adenoma.
claim_b: Follicular thyroid carcinoma can be reliably diagnosed on cytology alone without evaluating capsular invasion.
rationale: Mutually exclusive diagnostic criteria.

claim_a: BRAF V600E mutations are found in approximately 40-50% of cutaneous melanomas.
claim_b: BRAF V600E mutations are exceedingly rare in cutaneous melanoma, occurring in less than 5% of cases.
rationale: Conflicting frequency claims.

claim_a: Lymphovascular invasion is an independent adverse prognostic factor in stage II colorectal carcinoma.
claim_b: Lymphovascular invasion has no independent prognostic significance in stage II colorectal cancer.
rationale: Direct contradiction of independent prognostic value.

claim_a: Perineural invasion in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is associated with shorter overall survival.
claim_b: Perineural invasion does not affect overall survival outcomes in resected pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
rationale: Opposing survival associations.

claim_a: ER expression in invasive breast carcinoma is assessed by nuclear immunohistochemical staining.
claim_b: HER2 amplification in gastric adenocarcinoma can be confirmed by fluorescence in situ hybridization.
rationale: Different biomarkers and tumor types.

claim_a: Papillary thyroid carcinoma shows nuclear grooves, pseudoinclusions, and overlapping nuclei.
claim_b: Medullary thyroid carcinoma is composed of polygonal cells with amyloid stromal deposits.
rationale: Different thyroid tumor types with distinct morphologies.

claim_a: Synovial sarcoma harbors the SS18-SSX fusion resulting from t(X;18) translocation.
claim_b: Alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma typically carries a PAX3-FOXO1 or PAX7-FOXO1 gene fusion.
rationale: Different sarcoma fusions and entities.

claim_a: POLE-mutated endometrial carcinomas show excellent prognosis despite high-grade morphology.
claim_b: Tumor budding at the invasive front is a poor prognostic factor in oral squamous cell carcinoma.
rationale: Different organs and prognostic parameters.

claim_a: PDGFRA D842V-mutated gastrointestinal stromal tumors are resistant to standard imatinib therapy.
claim_b: ALK-rearranged lung adenocarcinomas show robust responses to crizotinib and second-generation ALK inhibitors.
rationale: Different tumor types and targeted therapies.

claim_a: High-grade papillary urothelial carcinoma shows marked nuclear pleomorphism and disorganized architecture.
claim_b: Pilocytic astrocytoma is a WHO grade 1 tumor with biphasic compact and loose microcystic areas.
rationale: Unrelated tumors and grading systems.

claim_a: INSM1 has emerged as a sensitive nuclear marker for neuroendocrine differentiation in carcinomas.
claim_b: SALL4 is a useful immunohistochemical marker for germ cell tumors including yolk sac tumor.
rationale: Different IHC markers for unrelated tumor categories.

claim_a: Depth of invasion through the muscularis propria defines T3 disease in gastric adenocarcinoma staging.
claim_b: Mitotic count per 10 high-power fields is a key parameter in grading uterine leiomyosarcoma.
rationale: Different organ systems and assessment parameters.

claim_a: Lichen planus exhibits a band-like lymphocytic infiltrate at the dermo-epidermal junction with basal vacuolar change.
claim_b: Acute appendicitis demonstrates transmural neutrophilic infiltration with mucosal ulceration of the appendix.
rationale: Completely different pathologies.

claim_a: BRCA1 germline mutations predispose to high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma with prominent SET-pattern morphology.
claim_b: VHL gene inactivation underlies the pathogenesis of clear cell renal cell carcinoma and hemangioblastomas.
rationale: Different hereditary cancer syndromes and tumors.
